text: Hanoi, 2021. Delivery driver Nguyen Ngoc Manh was waiting for a customer when residents cried out. A little girl was *hanging from a 12th-floor balcony.* He climbed onto a low roof and stood under her. Then she fell. "Luckily, *the baby fell into my lap,*" he said. She survived. *The Prime Minister honoured him.* Hit like for people who don't look away.
title: The Catch From the 12th Floor 🙌❤️
